_about: The neutral theme, and the default. Every word or picture that would name one particular lab lives in a theme file; this one names none. Another theme only needs the keys it changes: the rest fall back to these.

text.chronicle_foot: — live from the watch · click any watching to open it —
text.tribute_sub: The hypervisor divides its memory and its processors among its guests
text.annals_empty: nothing has happened on the map yet — the annals begin at the first change the watch sees.
text.colours_sub: the bar and the sky and depths
text.scheme_hint: Light/Dark keeps the bar light over the sky and dark over the depths. Saved in this browser.
text.tp_sub: where the wiring is drawn: every card, cable and stub, live
text.tp_empty: Nothing to draw yet. Places, routes and cables appear here as the map gains them.
text.tp_find: Find a place, address or port
text.tp_vlans_none: No VLAN is named on this map yet.
text.tp_lg_trunk: Striped: a trunk, a stripe per VLAN
text.tp_lg_route: Dotted: a route or a host, no cable known
text.tp_keys: Arrows pan the canvas and step between cards (Shift pans from a card), + and - zoom, 0 fits, Enter opens a card, Ctrl+F finds.
text.tp_x_svg_title: Save the whole drawing as an SVG file, as it looks now
text.tp_x_png_title: Save the whole drawing as a picture, at twice its size
text.tp_x_csv_title: Save every connection as a spreadsheet
text.tp_x_report_title: Print the map, its connections, what is down and the certificates near their end, or save them as a PDF
text.tp_x_busy: One file at a time: the last one is still being made.
text.tp_x_png_reduced: Saved {file} at {pct}% of the drawing size, as twice its size is more than a picture can hold.
text.tp_x_png_canvas: This browser could not paint a picture that large.
text.tp_x_failed: The file could not be made: {why}
text.tp_x_external: The drawing reached outside itself, so it was not saved.
text.tp_x_partial: Only {got} of {want} cards could be drawn, so no file was made.
text.tp_x_rp_map: The map, every device and the cables between them
text.tp_x_rp_conn_none: No place on this map yet.
text.tp_x_rp_down_nofeed: No live word has come yet, so nothing can be said to be down.
text.tp_x_rp_certs_none: No certificate has lapsed or lapses within 14 days.
text.tp_draw_keys: Drag a card to move it, or Alt and an arrow. Draw cables: drag from one card to another, or press one and then the other; press a cable, or Enter on it, to change it.
text.tp_draw_title: Lay a cable between two cards, or press a cable to change it
text.tp_draw_on: Drawing cables. Drag from one card to another, or press one card and then the other. Escape stops.
text.tp_draw_pick: {name} is end A. Now press the card at the other end, or Escape to let go.
text.tp_draw_group: Open the group first: a cable joins two things, not a group.
text.tp_add_stub_title: Gear on the wiring that is not a place: the line in, a wall jack, a desk switch
text.tp_from_routes_title: Make a cable for each route that has none yet
text.tp_remove_sure: Remove again to take it out
text.tp_cable_saved_ports: Cable {id} saved, and {n} new ports added to their places.
text.tp_cable_saved_port: Cable {id} saved, and 1 new port added to its place.
text.tp_cable_gone: That cable is no longer on the map.
text.tp_same_end: A cable needs two different ends.
text.tp_stub_saved: {name} added. It is a card now: draw a cable to it.
text.tp_routes_lead: Each route here joins two places with no cable between them yet. Each one ticked becomes a cable marked assumed, with no ports, until someone gives it them.
text.tp_routes_none: Every route already has a cable.
text.tp_routes_more: The first {n} are listed. Make these, then open this again for the rest.
text.tp_rearrange_ask: Re-arrange throws away where the cards were put. Press Re-arrange again to do it.
text.tp_rearranged: Laid out afresh. The saved layout is gone.
text.tp_layout_conflict: Someone else moved cards on this map. The layout was read again: move the card again if you still want it there.
text.tp_layout_failed: Where the card was put could not be saved: {why}
text.tp_conflict: Someone else saved the map first. It was read again: look, then try again.
text.tp_readonly: This Atlas is read-only, so nothing here can be saved.
text.tp_editor_failed: The map editor could not be opened: {why}
text.tp_dx_title: Ask the selected place from the head of the network down, and light the way as far as it answers
text.tp_dx_not_place: A stub or a folded group has nothing to ask. Pick a place.

text.nodes_not_drawn: That place is not on the map yet. Try again in a moment.

text.nodes_armed_one: Yes, I have checked this one
text.nodes_m_need: Say what the work is, and when it opens and closes.

text.nodes_s_gone: That collection is not there any more. Pick another.

text.nodes_n_needed: Pick at least one place they need.
text.nodes_n_unchanged: Nothing to change: they already say so.
text.nodes_stamps: Like a save in the map editor, this also marks them as checked.
text.nodes_stale_table: The map changed since this table was drawn. It has been drawn again: check the selection and press again.
text.nodes_readonly: This Atlas is read-only. Nothing here will save.
text.nodes_editor_failed: The map editor could not be opened: {why}
text.nodes_phone_bulk: Bulk actions need a wider screen.
text.nodes_rail_empty_saved: None yet. Filter the table, then save the filter.
text.nodes_rail_remove_note: Removing a collection takes no place off the map.
text.nodes_rail_remove_rules: Alert rules that watch it will stop sending: {rules}. With alerts on, they wait in Settings › Alerts, under Rules on something gone, to be removed.
text.nodes_bell_held: Alerts on {name}: none can send (behind an access group)
text.nodes_svc_none: No service charted on this place.
text.nodes_sc_out: Take it out of this collection
text.nodes_sc_none: No collection yet: make one in the rail first.
text.nodes_rail_gone_services: {n} of its services are no longer on the map (the place went, or the service was renamed).
text.nodes_rail_gone_service: One of its services is no longer on the map (the place went, or the service was renamed).

text.nodes_rail_tidied: Took {n} services no longer on the map out of {name}.

text.nodes_unmanaged_through: Still unmanaged through {names}: watch the collection again.

text.nodes_already: Nothing to change: it is already so.

text.nodes_unmanaged_note: Unmanaged: on the map, greyed, takes no state and raises nothing. Like a save in the map editor, this also marks them as checked.

text.nodes_menu_check_now_unmanaged: Check now: unmanaged, so not watched

text.ov_failed: The overview could not be read: {why}
text.ov_not_drawn: That place is not on the map yet. Try again in a moment.

text.ov_states_degraded_one: No place is down; {n} of {total} is degraded.
text.ov_states_degraded: No place is down; {n} of {total} are degraded.

text.ov_states_quiet: No place is down; {n} of {total} are up.
text.ov_down_undeclared: Nothing is declared to depend on these.
text.ov_down_undeclared_it: Nothing is declared to depend on it.

text.ov_fav_how: Mark a service as a favourite in the map editor, under its place.
text.alerts_failed: The alerts could not be read: {why}
text.alerts_off_both: Atlas sends nothing until two settings are in its environment: ATLAS_ALERTS=1, and ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS listing the hosts it may send to, for example ntfy.example:443. No host is listed yet.
text.alerts_off_flag: The hosts it may send to are listed in ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS. Set ATLAS_ALERTS=1 as well to turn alerts on.
text.alerts_off_hosts: ATLAS_ALERTS is set, but ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS lists no host, so there is nowhere Atlas may send. List them as host:port, for example ntfy.example:443.
text.alerts_off_restart: Restart Atlas after changing its environment. Destinations and rules can be made once it is on.
text.alerts_poll_needed: Alerts need the annals' poll; it is off. Set ATLAS_ANNALS_POLL above 0 and run Atlas under gunicorn, or nothing will be sent.
text.alerts_poll_dead: Alerts need the annals' poll, and it is not running: it runs under gunicorn, never under flask run. Nothing is sent until it does.
text.alerts_no_link: ATLAS_PUBLIC_URL is not set, so messages will carry no link to the place.
text.alerts_stale: Someone changed the alerts while you were editing. They have been read again: make your change once more.
text.alerts_fix: That was not saved. Put these right first:
text.alerts_fix_form: That was not saved. The form says what to put right.
text.alerts_dest_none: There is nowhere to send yet. Add a destination first; a rule sends to one.
text.alerts_discord_url_hint: The webhook's address up to its id. The operator lists discord.com:443 in ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS first.
text.alerts_discord_secret_hint: The token, the part of the webhook's address after the id: the server reads it from ATLAS_ALERT_SECRET_<NAME> or its _FILE; Atlas never stores it.
text.alerts_secret_hint: The server reads ATLAS_ALERT_SECRET_<NAME> or its _FILE; Atlas never stores the secret.
text.alerts_secret_unbound: the address changed, so ATLAS_ALERT_SECRET_{name} is not sent to it: edit it to name the secret again
text.alerts_in_use: Rules send here: {names}. Change them first.
text.alerts_f_minutes: And stays for (minutes; 0 sends at once)
text.alerts_resolution: Atlas looks every {n} seconds, so a wait is measured to the nearest {n} seconds.
text.alerts_resolution_off: Atlas measures a wait at the annals' poll, which is off.
text.alerts_suspended: Suspended: what it watches is hidden from a viewer with no groups, so nothing about it is sent.
text.alerts_rule_now: When {target} goes {states}, send to {dest} at once.
text.alerts_rule_wait: When {target} goes {states} and stays for {wait}, send to {dest}.
text.alerts_t_gone_place: a place no longer on the map ({id})
text.alerts_t_gone_collection: a collection that no longer exists ({id})
text.alerts_t_gone_network: a network no longer on the map ({id})
text.alerts_t_gone_service: a service no longer on the map ({id})
text.alerts_need_minutes: The wait is a whole number of minutes, from 0 to 1440.
text.alerts_need_url: Give the address to send to.
text.alerts_need_secret: Name the secret this kind sends; it cannot send without one.
text.alerts_bad_url: The address must start with https:// or http://.
text.alerts_bad_userinfo: The address may not carry a user name or password. Name a secret instead.
text.alerts_bad_query: The address may not carry a query (?…). Name a secret instead.
text.alerts_bad_host: {host} is not in ATLAS_ALERT_HOSTS, so Atlas will not send there.
text.alerts_bad_fragment: The address may not carry a fragment (#…).
text.alerts_bad_ntfy: An ntfy address names its topic, as https://ntfy.example/atlas.
text.alerts_bad_gotify: A Gotify address is the server itself, or ends in /message.
text.alerts_bad_secret: A secret's name is capitals, digits and _ only, at most 40 of them, as NTFY_LAB.
text.alerts_need_hour: The hour is a whole number from 0 to 23.
text.alerts_need_cert_days: Certificate days are a whole number from 1 to 365.
text.alerts_need_review_days: Review days are a whole number from 1 to 3650.
text.alerts_f_drift: Monitors the map has not charted
text.alerts_f_uncharted: Devices a source sees that the map has not charted
text.alerts_digest_off: The daily digest is not sent.
text.alerts_d_drift: monitors the map has not charted
text.alerts_d_uncharted: devices the map has not charted
text.alerts_deliveries_failed: The deliveries could not be read: {why}
text.alerts_l_fold: The changes held back by the rate limit
text.alerts_setup_sub: where word goes, the daily digest, the log
text.alerts_setup_note: Where alerts are sent, the daily digest, and what was sent. The rules are made in NODES: a place’s bell, or the ⋯ beside a collection or a network.
text.alerts_panel_none: No rule of its own yet.
text.alerts_panel_no_dest: A rule sends to a destination, and there is none yet.
text.alerts_panel_setup: Destinations, the daily digest and the log are in Settings › Alerts.
text.alerts_panel_unmanaged: No rule sends for this place: it is unmanaged, not ours to watch, so it has no state to send about. Its own rules are listed here to be removed.
text.alerts_panel_held: No rule sends for this place: it is behind an access group, and the alerts read the map as someone with no group does. Its own rules are listed here to be removed; a new one could not be saved.
text.alerts_orphans_note: These rules watch a place, a collection or a network that is no longer on the map, so NODES has no bell for them, and they send nothing. Remove them here, or bring their target back.
